deployments.name: Name

deployments.delivery_help: The task either runs the script from SYSVOL or carries it in its command line. Both are tested; embedded does not depend on SYSVOL access at run time.
deployments.links_help: The GPO applies to the computers below the selected containers.

guide.title: Guide
guide.how_1: Search a package in the winget community repository and add it to a deployment.
guide.how_2: The module writes one GPO per deployment into Active Directory, with a scheduled task per package that runs as SYSTEM.
guide.how_3: The GPO is linked to the whole domain or to organizational units. Every computer below applies it, and every later change, at its next policy refresh: at start-up, about every 90 minutes, or with gpupdate.
guide.how_4: At the next scheduled time the task runs winget on the computer: it installs or updates the package from the vendor's download, checked against the hash in the repository. A start time that already passed is not caught up.
guide.how_5: "Run now" adds a one-time task: every computer runs the packages once at its next policy refresh, independent of the schedule.
guide.account_help: The module writes GPOs with a service account of its own. It must not be a domain admin. The rights go to the group windeploy-admins and the account is its member, so another account can take over later:
guide.right_group: Group windeploy-admins, itself a member of Group Policy Creator Owners: write access to the Policies folder in SYSVOL; every GPO of the module gives it full control
guide.right_create: Delegated right to create GPO objects in CN=Policies (Samba does not give it to the group above)
guide.right_link: Delegated right to write gPLink and gPOptions where GPOs are linked (domain root or organizational units)
guide.account_ok_desc: {user} has all rights the module needs.
guide.auto_help: For a domain of this cluster the module creates the account itself under {settings}, with domain admin credentials that are used once and not stored. The account gets a random password only the module knows.
guide.auto_no_domain: No Active Directory domain of this cluster found: use the commands below on the domain controller.
guide.admin_user_helper: A member of the Domain Admins group. If another name was chosen when the domain was set up, or administration was handed to another account, enter that account.
guide.auto_done_desc: {user} was set up and stored in the settings.
guide.manual_help: On the node of the domain controller (the values of the selected domain are filled in):
guide.manual_ou: Step 6 covers all organizational units of the domain, also ones created later. Then enter the account and its password under {settings}.
guide.cmd_create: Create the account (asks for the password) and keep the password from expiring.
guide.cmd_group: Create the group, add the account and give the group write access to SYSVOL.
guide.cmd_sid: Get the SID of the group (for the following commands).
guide.clients_1: Windows 10 or 11 joined to the domain
guide.clients_2: App Installer (winget) from the Microsoft Store; version 1.21 as shipped with some images is too old: update it or install it from github.com/microsoft/winget-cli.
guide.clients_3: Internet access to the vendor downloads
guide.error_admin_bind_failed: Login failed. The reason is in the logs of the module.
guide.error_admin_not_allowed: This account may not create users or change permissions
guide.error_setup_failed: Setting up the account failed, see the module log
guide.error_dc_not_resolved: No domain controller known for this domain
guide.delivery_sysvol: The script lies in the GPO folder in SYSVOL; the task starts it from there (\\domain\SysVol\...). Readable in the GPO and easy to check, but the computer must reach SYSVOL when the task runs.
guide.delivery_embedded: The script is part of the task's command line (-EncodedCommand). The task needs nothing but itself at run time, e.g. on a laptop outside the office; the script is not readable in plain text in the GPO.
guide.delivery_choice: Both are tested; the default for new deployments is set under {settings}.
guide.link_domain: The GPO applies to every computer of the domain.
guide.link_ou: The GPO applies only to computers in this organizational unit and the ones below it. The Domain Controllers unit is not offered: on NS8 the domain controllers are Samba servers, not Windows computers.
guide.link_computers: New computers are placed in the Computers container, which is not an organizational unit: they only get deployments linked to the whole domain until they are moved into an organizational unit. When linking, the module can create a missing OU empty; computers are moved into it with an AD tool (e.g. RSAT or LDAP Admin).
guide.mode_upgrade: Updates the package on computers where it is installed; on the others nothing happens.
guide.mode_install: Installs the package where it is missing and updates it where it is installed.
guide.mode_msi: Prefer MSI packages (e.g. Google.Chrome instead of Google.Chrome.EXE): some EXE installers wait for a desktop when they run as SYSTEM. The script stops winget and the installer after 30 minutes without a result (in the log: exit code 1460); the task itself is stopped after two hours.
guide.how_6: This server only reads the index and writes the GPO; the computers download the software themselves.
guide.cmd_gpo: Give the right to create GPOs.
guide.cmd_link: Give the right to link GPOs to the domain (gPLink, gPOptions).
guide.clients_4: No VC++ redistributable needed: the script puts the runtime of winget on its search path.
guide.cmd_link_ous: Give the right to link GPOs to organizational units (inherited, also for OUs created later).
guide.cmd_create_ou: Optional: give the right to create empty organizational units (when linking a new OU).
guide.switch_help: Another account takes over as soon as it is a member of windeploy-admins: enter it under Settings, the rights check shows whether it may change the existing GPOs. The automatic setup does both and also hands over GPOs an earlier account created without the group. The old account stays; when it is no longer needed, remove it from the group or delete it.
guide.mode_scope: When a package has a machine-wide installer, the script asks for it (--scope machine), e.g. the MSI of Nextcloud.Talk; otherwise winget readily takes the per-user installer even as SYSTEM, which then hangs. Packages that only install per user cannot be deployed this way: the module refuses them when saving.
guide.lifecycle_1: A rule applies as long as it exists: a computer deletes the task of a package at its next policy refresh when the package leaves the deployment, the GPO is removed, or the computer moves to an OU the GPO does not apply to - also months later. Installed software stays.
guide.lifecycle_2: Removing a deployment deletes its GPO.
guide.lifecycle_3: Removing the module deletes the GPOs of all its deployments. Moving it to another node keeps them.
guide.lifecycle_4: A clone of the module starts without deployments; a restore brings them back.
guide.lifecycle_5: A computer that was switched off at the scheduled time catches up after its next start or policy refresh. A computer that gets a deployment for the first time waits for the next scheduled time.

policies.title: Policies
policies.help: A policy profile is a GPO with security settings for the computers of a domain or of organizational units. The settings apply as long as the profile exists and is linked.
policies.domain_title: Set at the domain, not by a profile
policies.domain_help: Read from the domain. In a Samba domain the password policy of the domain accounts is changed in the domain settings of NethServer, not by a GPO.
policies.domain_password_value: at least {length} characters, {history} remembered, valid {age} days
policies.domain_no_lockout: Off: accounts are never locked after failed logons
policies.domain_bitlocker_no: The directory schema cannot store them
policies.empty_desc: Create a profile, pick its settings and link it to the domain or to organizational units.
policies.stays_hint: Stays on the computers when switched off, until the profile has reset it.
policies.reset_help: Switched off. The profile writes the Windows default until the computers have applied it.
policies.reset_drop: All computers have applied it: take it out of the GPO
policies.links_help: The profile applies to the computers below the ticked targets.
policies.reason_help: Kept in the list of changes.
policies.error_not_configured: Connect the module to a domain first (Settings)
policies.error_profile_not_found: The profile does not exist any more
policies.error_removal_pending: The removal is running; cancel it first
policies.names_help_process: The file name as powercfg /requests shows it under DISPLAY, e.g. RustDesk.exe. Letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore, ending in .exe.
policies.names_help_service: The service name (Get-Service shows it as Name), e.g. TermService. Letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore.
policies.cleanup_help: Taken out of the list; the computers remove it at their next policy refresh: {names}.

policy_param.caption: Title
policy_param.method: Encryption of system and data drives

session_lock.title: Lock the session when idle
session_lock.desc: Locks the screen after the given time without keyboard or mouse input, for every user of the computer.
session_lock.caution: Also locks control room and measuring computers: give them their own organizational unit.

display_requests_ignore_all.title: Lock also when programs keep the screen on
display_requests_ignore_all.desc: Windows ignores the requests of every program to keep the screen on, so the session locks after the set time also during a remote control session, a video call or a presentation. Requests that keep the computer from sleeping stay as they are. Remote control sessions without input from the other side are locked; the other side has to unlock with the credentials of the logged on user.
display_requests_ignore_all.caution: Also locks video calls and presentations without keyboard or mouse input. Needs "Lock the session when idle".

display_request_overrides.title: Lock also when these programs keep the screen on
display_request_overrides.desc: Only the listed programs and services lose their request to keep the screen on (powercfg /requestsoverride ... DISPLAY); everything else, and the requests that keep the computer from sleeping, stay as they are. Remote control sessions without input from the other side are locked; the other side has to unlock with the credentials of the logged on user. The guide explains how to find the name of a program.

logon_banner.title: Notice before logon
logon_banner.desc: Shows a notice that must be confirmed before anyone logs on.

hide_last_user.title: Do not show the last user name
hide_last_user.desc: The logon screen does not show who logged on last.

require_ctrl_alt_del.title: Require Ctrl+Alt+Del
require_ctrl_alt_del.desc: Users press Ctrl+Alt+Del before they enter their password.

block_microsoft_accounts.title: Block Microsoft accounts
block_microsoft_accounts.desc: Users cannot add Microsoft accounts or log on with them.

usb_block.title: Block removable storage
usb_block.desc: No reading from or writing to USB sticks, external drives, CDs and DVDs. Keyboards, mice and scanners keep working.
usb_block.caution: Also blocks measuring devices and licence dongles that appear as storage, and BitLocker sticks.

usb_bitlocker_write.title: Write only to BitLocker sticks
usb_bitlocker_write.desc: Removable drives without BitLocker can be read, not written to. Windows offers to encrypt them.
usb_bitlocker_write.caution: Devices that write exports to a plain stick stop working.

no_autorun.title: Switch off AutoRun and AutoPlay
no_autorun.desc: Nothing starts by itself when a medium is inserted.

bitlocker_policy.title: BitLocker: recovery keys into the directory
bitlocker_policy.desc: Sets the encryption method and makes BitLocker store the recovery key in Active Directory before a drive is encrypted. It does not encrypt by itself.
bitlocker_policy.caution: Applies to drives encrypted from now on; an encrypted drive keeps its method.

time_source_domain.title: Time from the domain
time_source_domain.desc: Computers take the time from the domain controllers only, hourly.

time_change_admins_only.title: Only administrators set the clock
time_change_admins_only.desc: Changing the system time is reserved for administrators.

timezone_change_admins_only.title: Only administrators set the time zone
timezone_change_admins_only.desc: Users cannot change the time zone. Leave it off for laptops that travel.

defender_enforce.title: Enforce Microsoft Defender
defender_enforce.desc: Real-time protection cannot be switched off, potentially unwanted apps are blocked.

firewall_enforce.title: Enforce the Windows firewall
firewall_enforce.desc: The firewall stays on in all network profiles. Rules stay as they are.

print_spooler_hardening.title: Harden the print spooler
print_spooler_hardening.desc: Only administrators install printer drivers, the spooler accepts no connections from the network.
print_spooler_hardening.caution: Computers that share a printer stop doing so.

block_onedrive.title: Block OneDrive
block_onedrive.desc: OneDrive does not sync files. Other sync clients are not affected.

ntlmv2_only.title: NTLMv2 only
ntlmv2_only.desc: Computers refuse the old logon methods LM and NTLMv1.
ntlmv2_only.caution: Old devices (scanners, NAS) may need them.

audit_extended.title: Extended auditing
audit_extended.desc: Records logons, lockouts, changes of accounts, groups and policies, started programs with their command line, and removable media in the security log.

eventlog_sizes.title: Larger event logs
eventlog_sizes.desc: Enlarges the security, application and system logs so that entries are kept longer.

powershell_logging.title: Log PowerShell scripts
powershell_logging.desc: Records the text of executed PowerShell scripts in the event log.

domain_pin_logon.title: Allow convenience PIN sign-in
domain_pin_logon.desc: Domain users can sign in with a PIN instead of the password. Applies to all computers of the linked OUs; it cannot be limited to single users.
domain_pin_logon.caution: Windows keeps the domain password in the vault of the computer for it. Security baselines such as the DISA STIG for Windows 11 (WN11-CC-000370) require the option to stay off. Windows Hello for Business is no replacement: it needs AD Certificate Services, which Samba does not offer.

dns.title: DNS
dns.help: The internal DNS zones of the domain. Records that Active Directory needs and records the computers register themselves are shown, not changed.
dns.zone_read_only: Read only: the module has no rights on this zone
dns.grant_title: Give the module rights on the zone
dns.revoke_title: Take the rights on the zone away
dns.grant_desc: The group windeploy-admins gets the right to create, change and delete records in {zone}.
dns.revoke_desc: The group windeploy-admins loses its rights on {zone}. The records stay.
dns.grant_admin_help: This needs a domain administrator. The credentials are used once and not stored.
dns.admin_user_helper: A member of the Domain Admins group. If another name was chosen when the domain was set up, or administration was handed to another account, enter that account.
dns.grant_failed: Changing the rights failed, see the module log
dns.only_changeable: Only records that can be changed
dns.name: Name
dns.name_help: Without the zone: printer for printer.{zone}. *.apps for a wildcard.
dns.pointer: Also keep the reverse record (PTR), if a reverse zone with rights exists
dns.pointer_kept: reverse record left as it was
dns.pointer_no_reverse_zone: no reverse zone for this address
dns.remove_desc: This record is deleted from the zone:
dns.zones_failed: Cannot read the zones, see the module log
dns.records_failed: Cannot read the records, see the module log
dns.error_invalid_zone: The zone name is not valid
dns.error_invalid_name: The name is not valid: letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, labels separated by dots
dns.error_invalid_address: Not a valid address of this type
dns.error_invalid_mx: Mail server and a preference from 0 to 65535 are needed
dns.error_invalid_srv: Host, port (1 to 65535), priority and weight are needed
dns.error_invalid_txt: The text is empty, too long (2000 bytes) or has control characters
dns.error_invalid_ttl: The TTL is out of range
dns.error_protected_zone_root: The records of the zone itself belong to Active Directory
dns.error_protected_ad_node: This name belongs to Active Directory
dns.error_protected_ad_zone: This zone belongs to Active Directory
dns.error_protected_domain_controller: This is a domain controller: its records are not changed here
dns.error_dynamic_record: The computer registers this record itself; it would overwrite a change
dns.error_record_not_found: The record does not exist any more, reload the list
dns.error_cname_not_alone: An alias (CNAME) cannot stand next to other records of the same name
dns.error_cname_present: The name is an alias (CNAME): it cannot have other records
dns.error_ptr_needs_reverse_zone: PTR records belong in a reverse zone
dns.error_reverse_zone_type: A reverse zone holds PTR records
dns.error_access_denied: The module has no rights on this zone
dns.error_group_missing: The group windeploy-admins does not exist: set up the service account first (Settings)
dns.error_admin_bind_failed: Login failed. The reason is in the logs of the module.
dns.error_admin_not_allowed: This account may not change the rights of the zone
dns.error_too_many_records: The zone has too many records to show
dns.zone_name_help: At least two labels. The zone is stored in the directory like the zone of the domain.
dns.zone_network_help: IPv4 with /8, /16 or /24, for example 192.168.1.0/24. The name of the zone is derived from it.
dns.zone_grant: Give the module the right to change the records of the zone
dns.zone_shadow_title: The zone answers for the whole name
dns.zone_shadow: Computers that ask this DNS server get only the records of this zone. If the same name exists on the internet, its public records are no longer reachable for them unless they are added here.
dns.zone_failed: The zone could not be changed, see the module log
dns.zone_remove_desc: The zone {zone} is deleted with all its records. Computers can no longer resolve its names.
dns.zone_remove_backup: The records are written to a file in the module state before, as a note of what was there. They are not restored automatically.
dns.error_invalid_network: Not a valid network, for example 192.168.1.0/24
dns.error_invalid_prefix: A reverse zone ends on /8, /16 or /24 (IPv6: on a multiple of 4)
dns.error_zone_single_label: The name needs at least two labels, for example lab.example.net
dns.error_zone_above_domain: The domain lies inside this name: the zone would take over the names of the domain
dns.error_protected_domain_zone: This is the zone of the domain: it is never deleted
dns.error_confirm_mismatch: The name does not match the zone
dns.compare_help: Sends the names of this zone to a public resolver over HTTPS. Nothing is changed.
dns.compare_failed: The comparison failed, see the module log
dns.compare_not_public: The public DNS does not know {zone}: there is nothing to compare, the zone is internal only.
dns.compare_show_all: Also show records that are equal or only internal
dns.compare_skipped: {n} names were not compared: too many in this zone.
dns.compare_nothing: No record differs from the public DNS.
dns.adopt_desc: The internal records of {name} are replaced with what the public DNS says now.
dns.adopt_delete_desc: The internal record of {name} is deleted. Computers that ask the domain controller then get no answer for it from the zone {zone}; the public DNS answers only if the internal zone covers nothing but this name and is deleted as well.
dns.adopt_alias_note: The public DNS has an alias (CNAME) here: every other internal record of this name is removed, an alias stands alone.
dns.error_public_dns_unreachable: No public resolver could be reached over HTTPS
dns.error_no_public_record: The public DNS has no such record any more
dns.compare_dnshelper: To change the public side instead, use the DNS helper of this cluster:
dns.compare_no_dnshelper: Changes here only touch the internal zone. The public side is changed at the DNS provider, or from this cluster with the module dnshelper.

removal.deployment_start: The computers delete the scheduled tasks of {name} at their next policy refresh. The GPO stays linked for the waiting period, so that computers that are rarely connected see the change too; then it is deleted. Installed software stays.
removal.policy_start: The settings of {name} are lifted on the computers. The GPO stays linked for the waiting period, so that computers that are rarely connected see the change too; then it is deleted.
removal.policy_stays: Windows does not remove these settings by itself. During the waiting period the profile writes the Windows defaults for them:
removal.deployment_cancel: The tasks of {name} are written to the GPO again as they were before the removal started.
removal.policy_cancel: The settings of {name} are written to the GPO again as they were before the removal started.
removal.deployment_delete: The waiting period is over. The GPO of {name} is unlinked and deleted.
removal.policy_delete: The waiting period is over. The GPO of {name} is unlinked and deleted.
removal.days_help: Afterwards the module deletes the GPO by itself (daily around 3 am). Default from the settings.
removal.error_removal_pending: The removal is already running; cancel it first
removal.error_removal_not_pending: No removal is running for this item
removal.error_removal_not_due: The waiting period is not over yet
removal.logon_start: {name} stops setting rights; at its next policy refresh every computer restores the logon rights of before. The GPO stays linked for the waiting period; then it is deleted.
removal.logon_cancel: The logon rights of {name} are written to the GPO again.
removal.logon_delete: The waiting period is over. The GPO of {name} is unlinked and deleted.
removal.scripts_start: The cleanup scripts run instead of the scripts of {name}; scripts without cleanup script stop running. The GPO stays linked for the waiting period; then it is deleted.
removal.scripts_cancel: The scripts of {name} are written to the GPO again.
removal.scripts_delete: The waiting period is over. The GPO of {name} is unlinked and deleted.

logon.title: Logon
logon.help: Sets who may log on to the computers of an OU: locally, by Remote Desktop, or explicitly not. Each rule is a GPO with user rights. A user right is not merged across GPOs: the list of the GPO applied last counts. The local Administrators always keep the logon.
logon.empty_desc: Create a rule, pick users or groups and link it to an OU.
logon.rights_help: A right that is set replaces the whole list on the computers. Rights that are not set stay as they are.
logon.right_interactive_help: Who may log on at the keyboard and screen of the computer (Windows default: Administrators, Users, Backup Operators).
logon.right_remote_help: Who may log on by Remote Desktop (Windows default: Administrators, Remote Desktop Users).
logon.right_deny_interactive_help: Who may not log on locally, even with the right above. Administrators and Domain Admins cannot be locked out.
logon.admins_kept: Administrators always stay in the list
logon.right_unset: not set (Windows default or other GPOs)
logon.search_invalid: Letters, digits, space, dot, hyphen and underscore, 1 to 64 characters
logon.search_failed: Search failed, see the module log
logon.links_help: Link to the OUs that hold the computers. The whole domain hits all computers and servers except the domain controllers.
logon.domain_desc: The rule then applies to every computer and server of the domain. A wrong list can lock users out everywhere.
logon.domain_confirm: Yes, link to the whole domain
logon.conflicts_title: Other GPOs set the same rights
logon.conflicts_desc: For each right only the list of the GPO applied last counts. The order is computed from the links; security and WMI filters are not taken into account.
logon.error_right_required: Set at least one right with a user or group
logon.error_domain_confirm_required: Confirm the link to the whole domain
logon.error_conflicts_unconfirmed: Other GPOs set the same rights; check and confirm
logon.error_name_in_use: The name is already in use
logon.error_rule_not_found: The rule does not exist any more
logon.error_removal_pending: The removal is running; cancel it first
logon.error_not_configured: The module is not connected to a domain

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.help: PowerShell scripts that run at every logon of a user or at every start of a computer. Each script set is a GPO; the scripts are stored in the folder of the GPO. For the removal, each script can have a cleanup script that runs instead of it during the waiting period.
scripts.empty_desc: Create a script set, enter a script and link it to the domain or to OUs.
scripts.part_logon_help: Runs at every logon as the user who logs on. Applies to the user accounts in the scope of the link: accounts in the default container "Users" are only reached by a link to the whole domain.
scripts.part_startup_help: Runs at every start of the computer as SYSTEM, before the logon. Applies to the computers in the scope of the link.
scripts.log_help: The list keeps size and SHA-256 of each script; the text before every change is kept in the GPO backups of the module.
scripts.sysvol_desc: Scripts are stored in SYSVOL. Every authenticated user of the domain can read them: do not put passwords or other secrets in them.
scripts.cleanup_help: Runs instead of the script during the waiting period of a removal, e.g. to delete network places it created. Without a cleanup script the script simply stops running.
scripts.secret_desc: {where}, line {line}: this line seems to hold a password. It would be readable by all domain users. Saving is possible anyway.
scripts.links_help: Logon scripts act on the user accounts, startup scripts on the computers below the linked target.
scripts.error_script_too_large: A script can be at most 64 KiB
scripts.error_name_in_use: The name is already in use
scripts.error_set_not_found: The script set does not exist any more
scripts.error_removal_pending: The removal is running; cancel it first
scripts.error_not_configured: The module is not connected to a domain
